findings.title: Skip installer identity validation when the webhook has not created the integration yet
findings.body: When no `Integration` row exists for this installation, this branch advances the pipeline without comparing `github_authenticated_user` to the installation sender. A delayed or missing installation webhook therefore lets the OAuth-authenticated user complete setup for an installation created by a different GitHub user, bypassing the identity check this change is meant to enforce.

findings.title: Missing sender metadata raises instead of handling the installation
findings.body: This lookup assumes every existing integration has `metadata['sender']['login']`, but `build_integration` only adds `sender` when the pipeline state contains it. If an existing integration has no organization integration and lacks that optional metadata, retrying setup raises `KeyError` and returns an error instead of completing or showing the intended installation failure.
